caption: A heavy wooden barrel being rolled up a plank onto a truck bed is let go halfway up, and it rolls back down to the ground.

sa.check: A heavy wooden barrel is being rolled up a plank toward a truck bed.
It is let go part way up the plank.
It rolls back down to the ground.
The plank leads up onto a truck bed.
The release comes first and the roll back follows.

pc.expect: The barrel goes up only while it is pushed; the roll back begins at the release and not before, and once on the ground it stays there.
pc.fail: The barrel rolls back while it is still being pushed up; or it stays put on the slope after being released; or it sets off again after coming to rest on the ground.

pc.expect: After the release it goes downhill along the plank, quicker the further it rolls.
pc.fail: The barrel carries on up the plank after being let go; or it slows as it rolls down; or it leaves the plank and floats.

pc.expect: The barrel turns as it rolls, keeps to the plank's line, and runs out onto the ground at the bottom.
pc.fail: The barrel slides down without turning; or it turns sharply off the side of the plank with nothing touching it; or it stops dead at the foot of the plank as though it had hit a wall.

pc.expect: The barrel stays a rigid drum and the plank stays a rigid board under it.
pc.fail: The barrel squashes or wobbles like rubber; or the plank sags and springs like a trampoline; or the barrel's staves come apart as it rolls.

pc.expect: One barrel, one plank and one truck keep their number and shape.
pc.fail: The barrel vanishes or a second one appears; or it passes through the plank or the truck bed; or it turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The barrel's wood and hoops, the plank and the truck stay the same.
pc.fail: The barrel changes colour or size; or the plank changes length between frames; or the truck changes shape.
